translation: matter-codex: control menu. Choose a section with the buttons below.
The detailed result was sent as a private Mattermost response. This action can include device-code data, so the channel card only shows that the action ran.

Use Projects as the main entry point: create a project, add accounts and repositories, create roles, create chats, then work in Mattermost channels. Advanced legacy flow tools are hidden under Advanced.
Project is a Mattermost team. Open a project dashboard to connect repositories, create agent roles, and create private chat channels.
Create a project or open an existing dashboard.
Start a developer-review flow from a form: choose repository, profiles, title, and task text. The flow id and working branch are generated automatically.
Check repository/profile settings or move to pending decisions.
Flows waiting for owner attention are listed here. Open a flow to approve, reject, rerun review, hold, resume, stop, or clean runtime resources.
Open flow start or check related settings.
Repositories connect the GitHub account, Mattermost channel, and webhook. Add a repository through account and branch selection, then use the repository card for access, webhook, and delete actions.
Choose a GitHub account, repository, and default branch.
An agent profile can use different OpenAI and GitHub accounts. Choose the account type below.
OpenAI uses device-code auth, GitHub tokens are provided by the owner.
Codex CLI is authorized through the Mattermost device-code flow, without a raw API key. Open the account list, then use account cards for status, cleanup, and delete actions.
Create an account, open the link, enter the code, then press account status again.
GitHub accounts can differ between agent profiles. Add a token here; matter-codex validates it and stores it in a managed Kubernetes Secret.
Add or update an account token, then open the account card to review username, email, and scopes.
Roles belong to projects and bind OpenAI, GitHub, prompt behavior, Kubernetes access, sandbox mode, and Codex config settings.
Create a role from a project dashboard or open the role list.
Chats are private Mattermost channels inside a project team. Add one or more roles and selected repositories.
Create a chat from a project dashboard or open the chat list.
A profile binds role, OpenAI account, GitHub account, Kubernetes access, sandbox mode, and prompt templates. Create or edit profiles with forms.
Check available roles and bound accounts.
Prompt templates are stored in PostgreSQL and edited from Mattermost. Open a template to edit Markdown, view placeholders, or test-render it.
Open the list, help, or test render.
Runtime manages Kubernetes Job/PVC resources for smoke, dev, review, and flow runs. List runs, inspect status, clean a run, or run confirmed retention cleanup.
Start a smoke run or dry-run cleanup.
System checks and settings. The buttons below show health, safe token/storage status, and switch the interface locale.
Advanced and deprecated tools: legacy developer-review flows, legacy profiles, prompt templates, runtime diagnostics, and system checks.
Use these only for diagnostics or compatibility.
The menu covers the primary button-driven UX. Choose a section below; fallback typed help remains available only through manual input.
Open a section or go back.
